title: IceCream Sandwich
description: This adds the item "Icecream sandwich" to the game craftable with 2 cookies together
body:
# ICECREAM SANDWICH MOD
**This mod is nothing special**, just some funny little mod I made! 
All textures made by Me, Mod made using MCreator! idk if thiss will sadly make my mod feel less good :(

This adds a the item Icecream sandwich, which is crafted from 2 cookies together![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c0e24a77e3d248e515bf958c5e728e4d2dc5439.png)
